name: Flutter
tools: Visual Studio Code with the Flutter extension

beginner.summary: For developers who are new to Flutter, such as web, back-end or native mobile developers moving to cross-platform apps. Covers the Flutter 3.50 SDK and tooling, the Dart that Flutter code needs, widgets, layouts and state, lists, go_router navigation, forms, async code, REST APIs and JSON, shared_preferences and SQLite, Material 3 theming, assets, Provider, device plugins, widget tests, and release builds for Google Play and the App Store.
prerequisites: Has written programs in an object-oriented language such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, C# or TypeScript
Uses Git and a terminal for everyday tasks such as cloning, committing and running commands
Has a laptop with 16 GB RAM and admin rights, an Android phone or emulator, and a Mac with Xcode 27 for iOS work
outcomes: Build multi-screen Flutter apps with Material 3 widgets, responsive layouts, lists, forms and go_router navigation
Load and save data through REST APIs, JSON models, shared_preferences and SQLite
Manage simple app state with setState, ChangeNotifier and Provider, and cover it with widget tests
Produce signed release builds and publish them to Google Play internal testing and TestFlight
